original_test_intent: Measure FP8, INT8, FP16, TF32, FP64 and FP32 cuBLAS GEMM using the specified shapes and 1,000 repetitions, then compare every mode with its matching DA-10997-001_v31 and Viking reference.
original_method: Pin cublasMatmulBench_v4 binary/hash/help and compatible CUDA/cuBLAS/driver; map GPU UUID/BDF; validate each P mode, dimensions, T/transpose/B and memory fit; resolve executable paths; preserve baseline and isolate load; run six tracked commands sequentially with telemetry/abort; retain raw logs/exit/metric units; compare per-mode references; clean contexts and verify health.
manual_activity: Benchmark owner approves binary/runtime, path and six-mode oracle; operator maps GPU and authorizes sustained load; agent may execute sequential validated commands.
required_inputs: Compatible GPU UUID/BDF, CUDA/cuBLAS/driver and selector
Validation of all P/m/n/k/T/ta/tb/B settings and memory footprint
DA/Viking per-mode metric/units/threshold and expected duration
Isolation, telemetry, timeout and recovery approval
safety_requirements: Never silently rewrite or execute an unknown absolute-root binary
Preflight matrices and workspace against free memory per mode
Run one tracked precision at a time and preserve failures
Do not reset GPU or reinstall runtime as cleanup
agent_execution_scope: Run six approved modes sequentially and capture raw logs
Report per-mode comparison without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve executable path and approve six parameter/oracle mappings

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic SGEMM omits FP8, INT8, FP16, TF32 and FP64 plus all source matrices and logs.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute the six exact source parameter sets with the verified binary at the approved path, one at a time, capture pipe-safe exit status and full logs, and compare each matching metric/reference.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All P modes, matrix dimensions, T=1000, transpose/B flags and named logs remain; malformed path is not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a six-row run manifest containing binary hash, exact argv, memory preflight, pipefail-aware exit, metric/units, reference and health deltas for each precision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes path resolution and per-mode acceptance explicit while preserving every command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One SGEMM or aggregate score cannot stand in for six arithmetic formats and shapes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Piped tee can hide benchmark failure unless the benchmark exit is recorded separately; repeated modes also create cumulative thermal load.

project_override_considerations: Benchmark owner maps each `-P` encoding to precision/accumulation semantics and defines the DA/Viking metric field and tolerance per mode.
expected_evidence: Approved executable path and six exact argv/memory preflights
Six complete raw logs with benchmark and pipeline exit statuses
Per-mode performance metric/units and DA/Viking reference comparison
dmesg/XID/AER/BMC/SEL deltas, cleanup/final health and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Restores all six precision branches, catches executable and pipeline-exit ambiguity, and defines per-mode reproducible evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Different precision modes exercise distinct tensor/core and accumulation paths; FP32 SGEMM cannot demonstrate FP8, INT8, TF32, FP16 or FP64 behavior. Matrix shapes and transpose flags affect algorithm selection and memory demand. An absolute path can invoke a different binary or fail, while `tee` may return success after the benchmark failed unless pipe status is captured.
